wb_raw.V_WB_PRICES_OBSERVER_HEALTH.partitioned_by: environment ORDER BY started_at DESC) = 1 ), last_any AS ( SELECT * FROM `project-fa311fc0-4d87-4781-986.wb_raw.WB_PRICES_OBSERVATIONS` QUALIFY last_success_observed_at, o.coverage_pct AS last_success_coverage_pct, o.expected_products, o.observed_products, o.missing_products, o.unexpected_products, o.missing_nm_ids, o.unexpected_nm_ids,
